structural_change: HBM-SU3 10-17 qcore r5 (coordinator 0dc): ot_hbm_su_static_qcore_r5 replaces the 66-root qcore (64 per-bank clk_rf + ctl + red; codex hbm_qcore_s_pinrung_r2, 76k FF on 330.48^2). One RF copy (8,192 flops) instead of six per-reader replicas, and only the selected word per read class is registered (raw k+1, rd k+2) instead of a raw/read_data register per (bank, reader) + bank-select mux: ~11.5k flops, ONE root clk_ctl (reducer SRAMs on it; g1 gate: clk_red reached SRAM clock pins, CTS refused a separate root). Read: per-sector word at k+1 from a per-sector address copy, sector select at k+2 (g1: 8,192-load address nets). Pins first (raw command/writer capture at k, decode after the flop). Same edges: commit k+1, rf_bword/rf_dsec k+3, scalar E+11; write-conflict FAULT +1 edge; invalid-read output words are don't-care (documented). Reducer SRAMs stacked on the 43.2 lattice; die faces kept (W slice, E channel, N clocks). Re-home: H-DIE-R7b/R8b grants put sucore_<q> beside its pgslices.
